retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white group portrait overlaid with vibrant neon pink hand-drawn doodles and rough-edged marker typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central group of five figures in high-contrast black and white photography, framed by a thin pink border and accented with neon pink digital paint strokes, hair highlights, and hand-drawn patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: Neon pink accents against monochromatic subjects
Rough hand-drawn lettering framing the central figures
Thin geometric border containing the photographic elements
Mixed media textures combining clean photography with messy digital ink
coreInvariants: Vibrant neon pink as the primary accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged horizontally across the center, with the middle figure slightly forward and larger.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure with neon pink hair and a striped shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large pink title at the top, down through the central figure, to the secondary title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Off-white textured background provides breathing room around the central framed collage.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows in the photographic subjects
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon magenta-pink for doodles, hair, and text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the desaturated subjects and the hyper-saturated pink accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rough, expressive brush script and blocky marker caps
letterConstructionRules: Uneven stroke widths mimicking a felt-tip marker
Inconsistent baseline and x-height for a DIY feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'x' in the top title is small and floating like a doodle
The 'H' and 'V' have elongated, expressive terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive pink script for the primary brand/name paired with widely spaced black block caps for the secondary title.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the energy and texture of the top title
Matches the DIY aesthetic of the bottom title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a group of five people in stylish clothing, centered on an off-white textured background. Add a thin neon pink rectangular frame around them. Apply neon pink digital paint to the hair of the central figure and add small pink doodle accents like dots and hatch marks on the clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title at the top in a large, neon pink hand-drawn marker script. Add the secondary title at the bottom in black, widely-spaced, hand-drawn block capitals.

verificationChecks: Is the pink neon and vibrant?
Is the photography high-contrast black and white?
Does the lettering look hand-drawn with a marker?
Is the bottom text widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., neon green instead of pink)
Number of figures in the group
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard clean fonts; must be hand-drawn style
Do not use full-color photography; must be high-contrast B&W

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between B&W and neon

postGenerationChecks: Check that the pink script overlaps the top frame
Verify the bottom text is all-caps and widely tracked
Ensure the central figure's hair is the primary pink focal point
Confirm the background has a subtle paper-like texture
Check that the doodles appear integrated with the subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W group photo + Neon Pink Marker Doodles + Thin Frame + Rough Hand-Lettering
